exclusions: HAS_VALUE literal binding and colon value-domain constraints are not graph Relation identities

generic RELATION_TYPE or RELATION_TOKEN syntax placeholders are not Relations
Operation names are Relations only when they are Relation tokens
open_decisions: Preserve case-distinct depends_on and DEPENDS_ON unless an explicit source-backed migration says otherwise.
Review old Relation Definition source claims and all 14 nested Formal claim children before promotion.
Confirm endpoint and classification scopes for model entities versus instances; inverse existence grants no direction permission or cardinality.
Coordinate : operator ownership and source-reference disposition before retiring the legacy IS_ALLOWED_VALUE_OF Definition.
operator_category_decision: Graph Relations and other CFEL operators are distinct.
notation_policy: The Current parser maps / to NARROWER_THAN, // to INSTANCE_OF and . to IS_PROPERTY_OF. Traversal direction can be opposite the Relation direction; an alias does not reverse an authored edge.

operator_reclassification_held.review: Value V is described without an admitted literal-vs-entity endpoint carrier; do not equate to HAS_VALUE or invent Value Node.
operator_reclassification_held.disposition: proposed retirement: allowed-value admission is a CFEL operator, not a Node-to-Node Relation; coordinate : operator and source references before retirement
operator_reclassification_held.formal_endpoint_signature: not established by source CFEL; endpoint interpretation/rewrite needed
operator_reclassification_held.derivation_gap: Current source does not establish Direct versus Derived for this Relation.

derivation_definition: Direct identifies a canonical Relation; Derived identifies a view of another Relation, independently of how underlying field values are obtained.
directional_named_forms: For any named Relation R, Host ((R)) Target and Target <((R)) Host select the same fact. Counts follow their written endpoints during normalization. A reverse view creates no separately authored fact and grants no permission or cardinality.
endpoint_universe_decision: Any declared model Entity or instance, including Carrier and CFEL; literals remain value bindings/operators.
subject_relation_decision: Keep GOVERNS and HAS_ACTIVE_SUBJECT distinct: governing authority versus active target/aboutness; no deprecation is assumed.

generic_signature_rule.implementation_limit: Draft model contract only; existing parser and evaluator support are not asserted.
